dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, the living room is so messy! We need to clean it up.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Alright, I can vacuum the floor and dust the furniture.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, then I will wipe the windows and take out the trash.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Whose turn is it to wash the dishes tonight?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's your turn, buddy! I did it yesterday.

story.text: The living room looks incredibly messy, so two roommates decide to clean it up together. One person vacuums the floor and dusts the furniture. The other person cleans the windows and takes out the trash, then reminds his friend that it is his turn to do the dishes.

questions.question: How does the living room look?
questions.suggested_answer: It is very messy.

questions.question: What does the first person offer to do?
questions.suggested_answer: He offers to vacuum the floor and dust the furniture.

questions.question: Who takes out the trash?
questions.suggested_answer: The second person takes out the trash.

questions.question: Whose turn is it to wash the dishes tonight?
questions.suggested_answer: It is the first person's turn.

vocabulary.meaning: Thời gian dài, thế kỷ (for ages: đã lâu lắm rồi)
Hàn huyên, chia sẻ tin tức mới

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.text: Oh my god, Mary? Is that really you?

dialogue.speaker: Mary
dialogue.text: John! Wow, what a coincidence! I haven't seen you for ages.

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.text: I know! You look exactly the same. We must catch up soon.

dialogue.speaker: Mary
dialogue.text: Definitely. Let's exchange our contact info so we can keep in touch.

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.text: Sounds perfect, here is my phone number.

story.text: John runs into Mary at a public place by absolute coincidence. They realize they haven't seen each other for ages. John suggests that they catch up soon, and Mary happily agrees to exchange contact info so they can keep in touch.

questions.question: Who does John run into?
questions.suggested_answer: He runs into an old friend named Mary.

questions.question: Have they seen each other recently?
questions.suggested_answer: No, they haven't seen each other for ages.

questions.question: What does John want to do soon?
questions.suggested_answer: He wants to catch up with Mary soon.

questions.question: Why do they exchange their contact info?
questions.suggested_answer: Because they want to keep in touch.

vocabulary.meaning: Có đủ khả năng chi trả
Thỏa thuận mua bán, mức giá hời
Ngân sách, số tiền giới hạn

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I really love this leather wallet, but it's a bit over my budget.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: It's high quality, sir. But I can offer you a ten percent discount.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Can you make it twenty percent? Then I can afford it right away.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Alright, since you are our first customer today, we have a deal.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Awesome! Thank you for the great deal.

story.text: A customer spots a high-quality leather wallet, but it goes over his budget. He asks the seller for a discount to afford it. The seller offers 10 percent, but the customer negotiates up to 20 percent. The seller finally accepts the deal.

questions.question: What item does the customer want to buy?
questions.suggested_answer: He wants to buy a leather wallet.

questions.question: Why does the customer ask for a discount?
questions.suggested_answer: Because the item is over his budget and he cannot afford it.

questions.question: What is the seller's first offer?
questions.suggested_answer: The seller offers a ten percent discount.

questions.question: What is the final discount percentage they agree on?
questions.suggested_answer: They agree on a twenty percent discount.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thank you for calling Sunrise Restaurant. How can I assist you?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book a table for a party of four this evening around 7:30 PM.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Let me check... Yes, we have a table available. Do you have any seating preference?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Could we get a window seat with a nice view if possible?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Certainly, sir. I have that reserved for you under the name David.

story.text: David calls the Sunrise Restaurant because he wants to book a table for a party of four. The staff checks the schedule and finds an available spot at 7:30 PM. David requests a window seat for a better view, and the staff happily confirms his reservation.

questions.question: How many people are in the customer's party?
questions.suggested_answer: There are four people in the party.

questions.question: What time does the customer want to arrive?
questions.suggested_answer: He wants to arrive around 7:30 PM this evening.

questions.question: What kind of specific seat does the customer request?
questions.suggested_answer: He requests a window seat with a nice view.

questions.question: Under what name is the table reserved?
questions.suggested_answer: It is reserved under the name David.

vocabulary.meaning: Làm thay việc, gánh vác hộ (cho ai)

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.text: Hello, Peter speaking. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.text: Hi Peter, I'm calling in sick today. I have a terrible stomachache and can't get out of bed.

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.text: Oh, that sounds bad. Don't worry about work, just focus on resting.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.text: Thank you. Do I need to find someone to cover my shift?

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.text: No, I will handle it. Take some medicine and recover soon.

story.text: An employee calls his supervisor to call in sick because a terrible stomachache keeps him in bed. The kind supervisor tells him not to worry about work. He offers to find another worker to cover the shift so the employee can recover soon.

questions.question: Why is the employee calling his supervisor?
questions.suggested_answer: He is calling in sick today.

questions.question: What health problem does the employee have?
questions.suggested_answer: He has a terrible stomachache.

questions.question: Does the employee need to find someone to cover his shift?
questions.suggested_answer: No, the supervisor says he will handle it.

questions.question: What advice does the supervisor give?
questions.suggested_answer: He tells the employee to focus on resting, take medicine, and recover soon.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Where to, sir?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.text: Please take me to the central train station. Can we put my large bag in the trunk?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Sure, let me help you with that. There's a bad traffic jam ahead, so it might take 20 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.text: That's fine, as long as I don't miss my train. Just drop me off at the main entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Here we are. The fare is eighteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.text: Here is twenty. Keep the change!

story.text: A passenger gets into a taxi and asks to go to the central train station. The driver helps him put his bag in the trunk and warns him about a traffic jam. Despite the traffic, they arrive safely. The passenger pays twenty dollars for an eighteen-dollar fare and tells the driver to keep the change.

questions.question: Where does the passenger want to go?
questions.suggested_answer: He wants to go to the central train station.

questions.question: Where do they store the large bag?
questions.suggested_answer: They put it in the trunk of the car.

questions.question: Why does the journey take twenty minutes?
questions.suggested_answer: Because there is a bad traffic jam ahead.

questions.question: How much tip does the driver receive?
questions.suggested_answer: The driver receives two dollars as a tip because the passenger says 'keep the change'.

vocabulary.meaning: Dùng chỉ nha khoa / Chỉ nha khoa

dialogue.speaker: Dentist
dialogue.text: Open wide, please. Which tooth is bothering you?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: This one on the lower left. The toothache keeps me awake all night.

dialogue.speaker: Dentist
dialogue.text: Ah, I see the problem. You have a small cavity here. I need to fill it.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Will it hurt, doctor?

dialogue.speaker: Dentist
dialogue.text: Not at all, I will numb the area first. Remember to floss and practice better brushing habits.

story.text: A patient visits the dentist because a severe toothache keeps him awake all night. The dentist examines his mouth and finds a small cavity on the lower left tooth. She tells him she needs to fill it, promises it won't hurt, and advises him to floss regularly.

questions.question: What problem brings the patient to the dentist?
questions.suggested_answer: A severe toothache brings him there.

questions.question: Where exactly is the pain located?
questions.suggested_answer: It is on the lower left side of his mouth.

questions.question: What is causing the toothache?
questions.suggested_answer: A small cavity is causing the pain.

questions.question: What dental care habits does the dentist recommend?
questions.suggested_answer: She recommends better brushing habits and regular flossing.

vocabulary.meaning: Mã số định danh cá nhân, mật khẩu thẻ

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.text: Hey, wait a second. I need to stop by this ATM to withdraw some cash.

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.text: Sure, go ahead. Don't forget to hide the screen when you enter your PIN.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.text: Of course. Oh no, this machine charges a three-dollar transaction fee!

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.text: That's annoying. Do you want to find another bank's ATM nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.text: No, I don't have time. I'll just accept the fee and take out fifty dollars.

story.text: A guy stops by an ATM to withdraw some quick cash. His close friend reminds him to cover his PIN for safety. The machine charges a three-dollar transaction fee, which annoys him, but since he lacks time to find another machine, he accepts the fee and takes out fifty dollars.

questions.question: Why does the guy stop at the ATM?
questions.suggested_answer: He stops there to withdraw some cash.

questions.question: What piece of safety advice does his friend give?
questions.suggested_answer: He advises him to hide the screen when entering his PIN.

questions.question: How much is the transaction fee for using this machine?
questions.suggested_answer: The transaction fee is three dollars.

questions.question: How much money does the guy withdraw in total?
questions.suggested_answer: He withdraws fifty dollars.

lessons.title: Asking for Help with a Heavy Box

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, could you give me a hand with this box? It's way too heavy.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure, I can help you lift it. Where does it go?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you so much. We need to carry it up to the third floor.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, up the stairs? Alright, let's lift it together on three. One, two, three!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Got it. Be careful, watch your step on the stairs.

story.text: A person asks a friendly stranger to give him a hand because his box is way too heavy to lift alone. The stranger agrees to help him carry it up the stairs to the third floor. They coordinate their movements carefully and lift the heavy object together.

questions.question: Why does the person ask for assistance?
questions.suggested_answer: Because the box is too heavy to lift alone.

questions.question: What phrase does the person use to ask for help?
questions.suggested_answer: He uses the phrase 'give me a hand'.

questions.question: Where do they need to bring the heavy box?
questions.suggested_answer: They need to carry it up to the third floor.

questions.question: What warning does the owner of the box give while walking?
questions.suggested_answer: He tells the helper to be careful and watch his step on the stairs.

dialogue.text: Do you know any good places to eat around here? I have a date tonight.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, I highly recommend 'The Ocean Breeze'. Their seafood is incredibly fresh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it very expensive? I don't want to blow my budget.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not at all. The prices are very reasonable, and the atmosphere is cozy and romantic.

dialogue.text: Perfect! That sounds exactly like what I'm looking for.

story.text: A guy needs a great dining spot for his hot date tonight. His friend highly recommends a place called 'The Ocean Breeze' because they serve fresh seafood. She assures him that the prices stay reasonable and the cozy atmosphere makes it perfect for romance.

questions.question: Why is the guy looking for a restaurant recommendation?
questions.suggested_answer: Because he has a date tonight.

questions.question: What is the name of the recommended restaurant?
questions.suggested_answer: The restaurant is named 'The Ocean Breeze'.

questions.question: What kind of food is the restaurant famous for?
questions.suggested_answer: It is famous for its fresh seafood.

questions.question: How does the friend describe the restaurant's prices and atmosphere?
questions.suggested_answer: She says the prices are reasonable and the atmosphere is cozy and romantic.
